title: Humain, Infra sign $667m financing deals to expand Saudi AI infrastructure
description: RIYADH: Saudi artificial intelligence company Humain has secured financing agreements worth up to SR2.5 billion ($667 million) from the National Infrastructure Fund, or Infra, to expand computing capacity and build power infrastructure for data centres in the Kingdom. The agreements build on a framework announced in Davos in January that outlined non-binding financing terms of up to $1.2 billion for the development of up to 250 megawatts of AI data centre capacity. title: Senator Tells Google to Let Schools Disable AI Features in Search
description: Sen. Ed Markey, D-Mass., sent a letter to Google on Monday telling the tech giant to allow schools to disable the artificial intelligence features within its search engine.

title: Meta’s Dave Wehner leaves to become CFO of AI start-up Fireworks
description: Dave Wehner has spent 14 years at Meta, more than eight of them as chief financial officer. On Friday, he announced that he is leaving his role as chief strategy officer to become CFO of Fireworks, an AI inference start-up. The Information first reported the move on Friday evening. title: Global media move to standardize AI use, with BiH being part of the process
description: SARAJEVO/BEIJING, November 9 (FENA) - The 7th World Media Summit (WMS), held in Beijing last week under the slogan "Media in the AI Era: From Consensus to Action," concluded with the unanimous adoption of the Beijing Consensus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the launch of the Global Media Initiative for the Joint Development of AI Application Standards.

title: DataLogix AI Launches Workplace Video Resources for Businesses Exploring AI and Robotics Training
description: New calculator, business owner guide and inquiry form help companies assess workplace video alongside existing business records.
